content: Invalid configuration of RunnableEntityArgument with incom- patible types (non-array) Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00072, SRS_Rte_00029 The RTE Generator shall reject a configuration if • a RunnableEntityArgument is present AND • the ImplementationDataType of the RunnableEntityArgument does not resolve to an Array Implementation Data Type AND • the ArgumentDataPrototype ’s ImplementationDataType is not compati- ble with the RunnableEntityArgument ’s ImplementationDataType .
